hero.title: I Design & Build Digital Experiences That Make an Impact.

about.heading: Turning Ideas Into Clean, Useful Digital Experiences.
about.lead: I'm Tanveer, a Full Stack Developer who enjoys the whole journey of a product — from the first sketch to the final pixel.
paragraphs: My background spans web design, UI/UX, frontend development, data work, and digital marketing. I care about how things look, how they work, and whether they actually help people. I approach every project with a problem-solving mindset and a strong attention to detail.

I'm constantly learning — exploring new tools, techniques, and technologies so the experiences I build stay modern, accessible, and performant. When I take on a project, my goal is simple: deliver something clean, useful, and worth trusting.

projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects that demonstrate my design, development, and problem-solving skills.

items.title: Portfolio Website
items.summary: A personal portfolio site focused on clean layout, subtle motion, and strong typography.
items.challenge: Build a premium, responsive personal site from scratch — no frameworks — with a fast load and easy maintenance.
items.solution: Created a small design-system approach with CSS variables, semantic HTML, and minimal vanilla JavaScript.
items.result: A fast, accessible portfolio that adapts cleanly from mobile to desktop and is simple to update.

items.title: Academic Learning Platform
items.summary: A user-focused learning interface designed around clear navigation and progress tracking.
items.challenge: Design an interface that keeps learners oriented across many courses, modules, and lessons.
items.solution: Mapped user flows first, then built a clean navigation system, progress indicators, and consistent card-based layouts.
items.result: An intuitive, low-friction learning experience validated with a clickable prototype and usability walkthroughs.

items.title: Data Dashboard
items.summary: An interactive dashboard that turns raw metrics into clear, sharable visual stories.
items.challenge: Make a large, messy dataset understandable at a glance for non-technical stakeholders.
items.solution: Cleaned and structured the data, then chose the right chart types and highlights for each metric.
items.result: A clear dashboard that supports quicker, more confident business decisions.

items.title: Business Website
items.summary: A professional company website balancing strong branding with clear user journeys.
items.challenge: Communicate credibility while keeping the site light, fast, and easy to navigate.
items.solution: Established a strong visual system, simplified the page structure, and optimized images and code.
items.result: A polished online presence that loads quickly and guides visitors toward meaningful actions.

items.title: Digital Marketing Campaign
items.summary: A focused campaign strategy with clear messaging, audience targeting, and results tracking.
items.challenge: Reach the right audience with limited budget and measure what actually works.
items.solution: Defined the audience and message, planned content across platforms, and tracked key performance metrics.
items.result: A measurable campaign that improved reach and engagement while keeping costs controlled.

items.title: Custom Landing Page
items.summary: A conversion-focused landing page designed to guide visitors toward a single action.
items.challenge: Turn casual visitors into clear, confident action-takers without a cluttered page.
items.solution: Kept one goal in mind, wrote benefit-led copy, and reduced every distraction outside the call to action.
items.result: A focused landing page that improved clarity and conversion while staying fully responsive.

process.heading: My Design & Development Process
process.subtitle: A clear, proven path from the first conversation to a finished product.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Understand goals, users, requirements, and the real problems worth solving.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Research, define scope, structure the content, and build clear wireframes.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Create a clean, consistent, user-focused interface that builds trust at a glance.

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: Build responsive, accessible, and performant interfaces with clean code.

steps.title: Test
steps.text: Test usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and cross-browser behavior.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Deploy the final product, document what matters, and provide ongoing support.
